traditions.title: Two traditions, one portrait of you

western.title: Western astrology
western.body: Your Sun, Moon and Ascendant are calculated from the exact moment and place of your birth: how you shine, what you feel and how others first meet you.

chinese.title: The Chinese zodiac
chinese.body: Beyond your year animal, the four pillars of your birth (year, month, day and hour) reveal your elements, your rhythm and your inner nature.

blend.title: The blend
blend.body: Where the two traditions agree, the message is clear; where they differ, new sides of you appear. Zodiac Blend weaves both into one coherent reading.

faq.title: Questions, answered
faq.a1: Zodiac Blend combines Western astrology and the Chinese zodiac into a single reading. Instead of choosing one tradition, you see how both describe you, and where they meet.
faq.q2: What is the difference between the free reading and the full report?
faq.a2: The free reading uses only your birth date to find your Western sun sign and your Chinese year animal. The full report uses your exact birth time and city to calculate your Sun, Moon, Ascendant and all four Chinese pillars, then explores them in six personal chapters.
faq.q3: Why do you need my birth time and city?
faq.a3: The Moon moves quickly and the Ascendant changes about every two hours, and both depend on where you were born. Your hour pillar in the Chinese system also depends on the time. The more precise your details, the more precise your report.
faq.q4: What if I don't know my exact birth time?
faq.a4: Enter the closest time you know. Your sun sign and your year, month and day pillars will still be accurate, but the Ascendant and the hour pillar may differ.
faq.q5: How and when will I receive my report?
faq.a5: Once your payment is confirmed, your report is prepared, usually within a few minutes. You can download it from your order page, and we also email you a private link. The link stays valid for 24 hours, so remember to save your PDF.
faq.a6: We use your details only to calculate and deliver your reading. Payments are handled by our secure payment provider, so we never see your card details, and birth data is deleted after a limited period.
